reviews.text: The Smoky Grill Burger is hands down the best burger in Dhanmondi. Extremely juicy!
Great loaded fries. Service was a bit slow on Friday night but the food made up for it.

menu.name: Smoky Grill Burger
menu.description: Charcoal-grilled juicy beef patty with smoky BBQ sauce, cheese, and caramelized onions.

menu.name: Cheese Blast Burger
menu.description: Double beef patty loaded with melted cheddar, mozzarella, and house special sauce.

menu.name: Loaded Fries
menu.description: Crispy French fries topped with melted cheese, jalapenos, and minced beef.

menu.name: Garlic Mushrooms
menu.description: Sautéed mushrooms in garlic butter, fresh herbs, and a touch of white sauce.

reviews.text: Consistent taste as always. Beef Cheese Delight is my absolute favorite.
Burgers are huge and filling. Banani outlet is nicely decorated.

menu.name: Beef Cheese Delight
menu.description: Classic grilled beef burger with double cheese slice, fresh lettuce, and signature Takeout sauce.

menu.name: Chicken Supreme
menu.description: Deep fried crispy chicken breast, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and spicy mayo dressing.

menu.name: Crispy Onion Rings
menu.description: Golden fried crispy onion rings served with sweet chilli sauce.

reviews.text: Best Kacchi Biryani in Dhaka. The mutton is so tender and falls off the bone.
Incredible taste, but the place is extremely crowded. Better to order home delivery.

menu.name: Mutton Kacchi Biryani - Half
menu.description: Traditional mutton kacchi biryani cooked with fragrant basmati rice, potatoes, and pure ghee.

menu.name: Jali Kabab
menu.description: Spiced minced beef patty coated in deep-fried egg net.

menu.name: Borhani
menu.description: Traditional spiced yogurt drink blended with mint, mustard, and green chillies.

menu.name: Firni
menu.description: Traditional sweet rice pudding made with thickened milk, saffron, and nuts.

reviews.text: The momos are highly authentic and juicy. Nice selection of Asian street food.
Love their Schezwan noodles. Perfectly spiced and loaded with shrimp and chicken.

menu.name: Chicken Steamed Momo
menu.description: 6 pieces of juicy steamed dumplings stuffed with seasoned minced chicken and served with spicy dipping sauce.

menu.name: Veg Steamed Momo
menu.description: 6 pieces of steamed dumplings filled with cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, and spring onion.

menu.name: Schezwan Noodles
menu.description: Spicy wok-tossed noodles with chicken, shrimp, vegetables, and homemade Schezwan sauce.

menu.name: Chilli Chicken
menu.description: Stir-fried boneless chicken cubes with bell peppers, onions, and green chillies in a soy sauce base.

reviews.text: Great spot for working. Coffee is premium quality and the environment is very peaceful.
Chocolate Fudge Cake is rich and not overly sweet. Pair it with a double espresso!

menu.name: Caramel Macchiato
menu.description: Freshly pulled espresso with steamed milk and vanilla syrup, topped with gourmet caramel drizzle.

menu.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
menu.description: A slice of rich, moist chocolate cake layered with decadent fudge frosting.

menu.name: Chicken Avocado Salad
menu.description: Grilled chicken breast, fresh mixed lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, avocado slices, and honey mustard dressing.

menu.name: Classic Waffles
menu.description: Freshly baked Belgian waffles served with whipped butter, berries, and maple syrup.
